description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class used for rendering the home screen's sections in an Android TV app. It includes view holders for header, banner, and content row sections, manages different view types, and handles focus navigation behavior within the home screen layout.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for rendering different sections (header, banner, content rows) of the home screen in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: SectionItem
classes.description: Sealed class representing different types of sections in the home screen, including header, banner, and content row.

classes.name: HeaderSection
classes.description: Data class representing the header section, including categories for navigation.

classes.name: BannerSection
classes.description: Data class representing a banner section with a list of banners.

classes.name: ContentRowSection
classes.description: Data class representing a horizontal list of content cards with a title.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for the item at a given position based on the item class.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder instances based on the view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder based on the item type.
